# Barbu Media Software

> Independent professional software from Zürich, Switzerland. Barbu Media builds focused native tools around complete real-world jobs in media delivery and visual documentation.

## Products

- [Finalova](https://barbumedia.com/finalova/): Native macOS software for adapting, captioning, reframing, compressing and delivering finished media across social platforms, websites and client channels from one coherent workspace.
- [Finalova editions](https://barbumedia.com/finalova/pricing/): Trial, perpetual and studio workflow options.
- [B/A Studio](https://barbumedia.com/ba-studio/): Native Mac and iPhone software for comparable before-and-after capture, rigid alignment, measured visual change and editorial publishing.
- [B/A Studio editions](https://barbumedia.com/ba-studio/pricing/): Subscription and lifetime options for practitioners and studios.
- [Software catalog](https://barbumedia.com/apps/): The current Barbu Media product catalog.
- [Store](https://barbumedia.com/store/): Direct editions and license information.

## Studio

- [About Barbu Media](https://barbumedia.com/about/): Founder background, field experience and engineering values.

## Core facts

- Publisher: Barbu Media Software, founded by Constantin Barbu.
- Location: Zürich, Switzerland.
- Platform focus: native Apple silicon software using Swift, Metal, Core Image and VideoToolbox.
- Privacy posture: local processing and on-device transcription by default, with no cloud harvesting of client media.
- Contact: support@barbumedia.com.
